posts.name: The Mariner
posts.cooked: Okay, so I noticed that Oblivaeon deals each non-Scion target 9999 infernal damage on "Impending Doom."  Time for a dumb question- could Visionary Twist the Ether to turn that into fire damage as it hits Absolute Zero in a Fixed Point, thus unleashing 9999 cold damage on Oblivaeon and trivializing the encounter? I assume there's an effect to avoid this situation, or a similar one. But my question- is it a Baron Blade-esque built-in wall on Oblivaeon itself or more of an environmental-style effect, but on a Scion?  Or perhaps is this the secret way that he heroes ACTUALLY beat Oblivaeon?
